items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: this was during the days when he had that great team of Bob Eberly and Helen OConnell.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Yeah. You also included Jimmy Dorsey here as -- when was this that you were writing for Jimmy Dorsey?

Well, I think that was in the '30's, early '30's, I think. I'm not too well up on that this morning with the times, so I (unintelligible) don't want to be misquoted. But I did a few things for him -- this was during the days when he had that great team of Bob Eberly and Helen OConnell.

but I did some original things for Jimmy. He liked those things, you know. He also had a publishing company. Seemed like in those days the guys wanted to do things for them that they could take over, and especially if they would record them. There was a royalty factor in that, plus the fact that -- well, they were business, you know.
